note: Authored against the conflicting-availability variant. Never sent to a model, so it carries no latency, token or cost figures. The point of this fixture is that the two staff records about A. recommendations.title: Attack the vacated left channel in the first half
recommendations.observation: Analyst notes record the Clifton left-back advancing beyond halfway in 14 of 18 build-ups across two matches, with slow recovery runs on both transitions conceded.
recommendations.inference: That pattern suggests the channel behind him is reachable on regains, though two matches is a small sample and Clifton may have adjusted since.
recommendations.action: Start A. Rivers wide right for the first 45 minutes and target the space behind the Clifton left-back on regains.
recommendations.trade_off: Commits the staff-supplied 45-minute allocation to the first half, leaving no wide 1v1 option after the break.
recommendations.uncertainty: Two observed matches only. Separately, the staff records disagree about A. Rivers: ev_staff_rivers_availability lists him available with a 45-minute cap, and the later ev_staff_rivers_availability_revised puts him under review after reported tightness. Nothing in the packet settles which is current, so this plan is provisional on his status being confirmed.
recommendations.next_check: Confirm A. Rivers's status with the staff before team selection, and confirm the Clifton full-back selection when the team sheet is published.

result.abstention_note: Only one option is proposed. A second would have rested on the same contested availability, so it is withheld rather than offered twice on one unsettled assumption.

warnings.message: Clifton Wire reports that J. Marsh trained fully, while an older Clifton Park FC statement lists him as a doubt. No freshness or authority rule settles which holds, so both records are shown rather than one being chosen.

Two staff records disagree about whether A. Rivers is available: the earlier one lists him available with a 45-minute cap, the later one puts him under review. Neither is authoritative over the other, so both are shown. The reported tightness is recorded as written; no medical interpretation is attached.
Two team-news records share origin org_clifton_wire and were treated as one report, not two independent confirmations.
